commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.

29' Junior Messias (Genoa) has a go from the edge of the box, but it's a harmless effort and sails well wide of the left post.

27' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Antonio Giua with no other option than to blow for a foul.
26' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Genoa.

22' Junior Messias (Genoa) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the crossbar, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic easily deals with the threat.
20' The free kick is whipped into the box and finds Alessandro Buongiorno (Torino), who plants a header just wide of the left post from close range.
